passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Lantana × strigocamara R.W.Sanders.

The native range of this hybrid is as naturally occuring between the naturalised species. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is L. camara × L. nivea × L. scabrida × L. splendens. It is used as a medicine.
